notes: Given recent events around George Floyd and far beyond, this special episode of the a16z Podcast features Shaka Senghor , a leading advocate for criminal justice reform (and bestselling author), and Terry Brown , a former police officer in East Palo Alto (who has since run his own security firms) -- who, incidentally, both grew up in Detroit but ended up on different sides of the law -- in conversation with a16z co-founder Ben Horowitz. The conversation goes deep and on the ground (please note that the discussion also includes details of violence, in case you have young children listening).
